name: My product
about: One short paragraph for reviewers who have never seen it: what it is, who it is for, what it promises. Leave the design direction out; it goes in rules.
rules: Constraints a fix must respect, shown to reviewers as not scored. For example: keep the existing navigation, light theme first with a dark theme.
persona: a first-time user of the product who has not seen it before and is not technical.

journeys.name: First visit
journeys.task: Open the product for the first time. Say what it is for and what to do first, then do that first thing end to end.

journeys.name: The main job
journeys.task: Do the one job people come here for, from start to finish, and confirm the result shows in the right place.

journeys.name: On the phone
journeys.task: Do journeys 1 and 2 on the phone: navigation, opening an item, going back, taking an action.

journeys.name: Keyboard and dark mode
journeys.task: Use only the keyboard (Tab, Enter, arrows, Escape) to do journey 2 and check focus is always visible. Then load the main screens with "scheme": "dark" and check everything is readable.

criteria.name: Clear
criteria.means: obvious what to do next and why, no jargon.

criteria.name: Quick
criteria.means: the fewest steps, nothing asked twice.

criteria.name: Trust
criteria.means: nothing happens without the person's say so; numbers show where they come from; nothing overstated.

criteria.name: Familiar
criteria.means: follows the conventions of the platform it runs on, so a first-time user already knows how it works.

criteria.name: Calm
criteria.means: what matters first, nothing cluttered or shouting.

criteria.name: Works everywhere
criteria.means: phone, keyboard, screen reader labels, dark mode, large text.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.when: once the first journeys reach 8 or more

criteria.name: Time to value
criteria.means: a first-time user gets real value quickly, measured step by step.

criteria.name: Error recovery
criteria.means: every failure ends in one plain sentence and one way forward.

criteria.name: Copy
criteria.means: plain English, no jargon, every number explained where it appears.

criteria.name: Agent experience
criteria.means: an AI agent can complete every journey through the product's command line or connector alone and gets the same result and the same refusals as a person.

criteria.name: Accessibility, measured
criteria.means: automated contrast and keyboard checks pass, screen reader labels are complete, 200 percent text size works, reduced motion is respected.

criteria.name: Speed
criteria.means: every screen draws in under a second; actions answer in under half a second.

criteria.name: Five-second test
criteria.means: a stranger shown the main screen for five seconds can say what to do next.

criteria.name: Emotional tone
criteria.means: honest and still encouraging; never discouraging, never flattering.

criteria.name: Consistency
criteria.means: the same words, icons and patterns for the same thing on every screen.

criteria.name: Data safety
criteria.means: nothing is lost on a refresh, a crash or a closed laptop; every change can be undone or is logged.

criteria.name: Delight
criteria.means: the moments that matter feel earned and worth sharing.
